keyword.en: how to read Diesel 120 Concrete Pump pumping distance
keyword.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵输送距离怎么读

title.en: Surveying does not replace what Diesel 120 Concrete Pump lists
title.zh: 「測量學」不能替换柴油120型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印列出的数字

description.en: Diesel 120 Concrete Pump. 150 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Surveying.
description.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印。150 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「測量學」。

h1.en: Surveying does not replace what Diesel 120 Concrete Pump lists
h1.zh: 「測量學」不能替换柴油120型混凝土泵的距离格子按什么顺序印列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 150 m / 500 m. Read each label with its own figure. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是150 m / 500 m。同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying: Surveying. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump distance text in Xingtai as follows: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 150 m / 500 m. Conveying Distance (H / V) is 150 m / 500 m. Maximum aggregate size is 6 cm and below. If a distance entry is missing on the Diesel 120 Concrete Pump sheet, it stays missing.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying页上的Surveying。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油120型混凝土泵的距离文字写成：输送距离（水平/垂直）是150 m / 500 m。管路沿程要克服摩擦，水平段和垂直升高不是同一项工作。柴油120型混凝土泵这一页如果少了某一距离格，就让它继续空着。

body.en: Read each label with its own figure. A pipeline loses pressure to friction, so a horizontal run and a vertical rise are different duties. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112 (two units). Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 40 MPa.
body.zh: 同一页如果同时有水平和垂直，两者不能对调；没有写出的垂直格也不能用别的型号去填。最大骨料粒径 6 cm and below。理论输送量是100 m³/h，最大出口压力是40 MPa。

body.en: Horizontal and vertical are not interchangeable when both appear, and a missing vertical entry is not filled from another model. The sheet already separates them when it lists both. Subject: Model Engine B Luc Viatour. Neither entry is a metre.
body.zh: 画面「Diesel engine」的主体是Model 发动机 B Luc Viatour，不能代替这些格子。液压泵 Kawasaki 112 (two units)。

body.en: The frame “Diesel engine” shows Model Engine B Luc Viatour and does not replace these entries. Hopper capacity is 0.6 m³. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not read a metre figure off that frame. Do not paste another manufacturer's boom length onto Diesel 120 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是150 m / 500 m。主体：Model 发动机 B Luc Viatour。

question.en: Which distance text does Diesel 120 Concrete Pump list?
question.zh: 柴油120型混凝土泵标出了哪几句距离？

answer.en: Conveying Distance (H / V) is 150 m / 500 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying.
answer.zh: 输送距离（水平/垂直）是150 m / 500 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can horizontal and vertical be swapped?
question.zh: 水平和垂直可以对调吗？

answer.en: Only when the label itself puts them in that order. Keep the shown order. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying.
answer.zh: 只有标题本身写成那个顺序时才按那个顺序。保留写出来的次序。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 100 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是100 m³/h。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Surveying画面里印出的数字。
